quote: The ability to enumerate all possible analyses of a graph facilitates surface realization, grammar induction, recursive graph embedding, etc.

A fundamental problem in modeling language production is parsing meaning representations, i.e. computing all possible analyses of a given meaning representation (MR) according to a (competence) grammar.
models: Graph parser with Hyperedge Replacement Grammar (HRG)
outputs: derivation forests, surface realizations from semantic graphs
